description: The Vealth titles register for one wallet: every title the worker declared on their own signature (CHST, OSHA 30, CPR, a guard card, anything), each with a status derived from the worker's OWN declared dates (current, expired, unknown_expiry), a verify pointer to the ISSUER'S record (we carry the link, we never fetch it), board evidence in that title's scope (on-chain-confirmed settlements and reviews the wallet accepted), and the declaration's anchor hash. Self-declared and shown as such; nothing here gates a claim or makes hiring, employment, qualification, or fitness decisions for an employer. Public mirror: https://vealth.net/labor/worker/<wallet>/titles. Free, keyless, read-only.
name: worker_titles
title: The titles and credentials one wallet declares, with status and evidence
